Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: CI & Release

# Workflow name based on selected inputs. Fallback to default Github naming when expression evaluates to empty string
run-name: >-
  ${{
    inputs.release && 'Test ➤ Publish to NPM' ||
    'Test'
  }}

on:
  # Build on pushes to release branches
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release:
        description: "Publish new release"
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read # for checkout

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    # We test on all of the maintained versions: https://nodejs.org/en/about/releases/
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: ["lts/-1", "lts/*", "current"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        id: node
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ steps.node.outputs.node-version }}
        run: npm install
      - run: npm run-script prettify-check
      - run: npm run knip
      - run: npm run test:generate
      - run: npm test
        env:
          CI: true
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm run test:bundle

  release:
    permissions:
      id-token: write # to enable use of OIDC for npm provenance
    name: Semantic release
    needs: build
    # only run if opt-in during workflow_dispatch
    if: github.event.inputs.release == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.ECOSPARK_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.ECOSPARK_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Need to fetch entire commit history to
          # analyze every commit since last release
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Uses generated token to allow pushing commits back
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          # Make sure the value of GITHUB_TOKEN will not be persisted in repo's config
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx semantic-release
        # Don't allow interrupting the release step if the job is cancelled, as it can lead to an inconsistent state
        # e.g. git tags were pushed but it exited before `npm publish`
        if: always()
        env:
          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: true
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
